test_MessageToString: test the text_format MessageToString function to serialize a protobuf message into human-readable text format
test_Merge: test the text_format Merge function to parse human-readable text back into a protobuf message object
test_MessageToString_as_one_line: test the text_format MessageToString with as_one_line flag to print nested messages on a single line
test_MessageToString_as_utf8: test the text_format MessageToString with as_utf8 flag to output raw UTF-8 bytes instead of octal escapes
test_ParseError: test that text_format Merge raises ParseError when given invalid text such as unknown fields or bad enum values
